title: Adobe Technology Consultant & Digital Practice Lead
fit_note: Senior leadership role driving EPAM's European Adobe technology consulting and growth strategy — explicitly described as wearing multiple hats (director of technology, senior technical consultant, account CTO, or Chief Architect) and leading technology consulting, architecture engagements, and major transformations through execution. Strong match for the desired shift toward strategy while staying technical/hands-on. Caveat: this exact posting was tracked and auto-expired once before (issue #25, opened 2026-09-10, closed 2026-09-25) — it's a recurring/evergreen EPAM opening that has resurfaced; it also carries a business-development/practice-growth component alongside the architecture work, and the exact remote/hybrid split wasn't confirmed from search results.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant, CXO (Customer Experience Orchestration)
fit_note: Senior pre-sales Solutions Consultant role at Adobe itself covering Customer Experience Orchestration (Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics) for enterprise accounts out of Zurich — pairs deep technical/architecture credibility with strategic customer-facing work, matching the move toward strategy without losing the hands-on component. Requires 8+ years in Solution Consulting or comparable pre-sales roles. Caveat: this same requisition (R169096) has been tracked and auto-expired twice before (issues #17 and #23) — it appears to be a long-standing/evergreen Adobe opening that stays posted for months, so it keeps cycling back into the 14-day tracker window.

title: Data Architect (Adobe AEP)
fit_note: Senior/architect-level role focused specifically on Adobe AEP data architecture — defining XDM schemas and identity strategy, overseeing batch/streaming/API ingestion pipelines, and setting data quality, governance, retention, privacy, and consent management frameworks. Strong technical-architecture match for Patrick's AEP/consent-management background, and open to candidates from any country so Switzerland-based remote work is viable. Caveat: posted via TechBiz Global, an IT recruitment agency, for an undisclosed end client (the same agency already has another open req, "AEP Multi-Solution Architect", tracked as issue #26) — worth clarifying the actual employer and whether these are the same or different engagements before applying.
